# TextLayout

[Toolkit](README.md) · `DotGame.Toolkit.Fonts` · class

```csharp
public sealed class TextLayout
```

Text wrapped to a width: lines broken at spaces, hyphens and line feeds, and between CJK characters with their punctuation rules, aligned, and cut off with an ellipsis past a number of lines. Set its [`Text`](#text) and properties, then measure it with [`Size`](#size) and draw it with [`Draw`](#draw) as often as you like: it works out its lines again when they're next needed after a change. It keeps its lines, so a layout that's reused allocates nothing once it's grown to its largest text.

## Remarks

Like the rest of the font code, it draws left to right, with no shaping. A word wider than the whole width breaks between its characters.
